note:
CI workflow written and verified locally. .github/workflows/ci.yml: push to main + PR to main, permissions contents:read, cancel-in-progress concurrency per ref, matrix node-version 20.x and 24.x (current LTS, Krypton) with fail-fast:false, actions/checkout@v7 + actions/setup-node@v7 with cache:npm, then npm ci --ignore-scripts / npm run lint / npm run build / npm test. No secrets, no live API call (smoke stays manual). actionlint 1.7.12 clean.

Finding: a plain `npm ci` FAILS on Node 20 — isolated-vm@6.2.0 (transitive dep of n8n-workflow) runs a native node-gyp build whose sources need v8::SourceLocation, absent from Node 20's V8 headers. Reproduced on a clean copy under real Node 20.20.2. Fixed by `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; no dependency install script is needed to lint/build/test (n8n-workflow is used for types only). Full sequence passes clean on Node 20.20.2 (npm 10.8.2) and Node 24.18.0 — 83 unit tests, 0 fail, on both. package.json scripts needed no change: `node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js` uses shell globbing and works on Node 20.

Docs updated: CLAUDE.md Deploy ("no CI yet" replaced) and docs/DESIGN.md (roadmap line + new "## CI" section explaining the matrix and --ignore-scripts).

PENDING, needs Farhan: (1) push .github/workflows/ci.yml to github.com/Biztactix/n8n-nodes-typesafe (not pushed, no gh workflow run, no tags per instructions); (2) confirm the first run is green on main; (3) add the CI status badge to README — deliberately left out, it would render "no status" until the workflow has run once. Also note: .project/INFRASTRUCTURE and DECISIONS still describe CI as absent/planned; left untouched for PM tooling to update.
